title: File:Black and white picture of a horse on a river bank. Houses and vehicles in the background (51151104640).jpg

input.title: File:Black and white picture of a horse on a river bank. Houses and vehicles in the background (51151104640).jpg

reproduction.method: shipped model over the eval set, offline CPU (ONNX Runtime)

observedProblem: The model returned a fully transparent mask: nothing of the subject survives. Every pixel is alpha 0.
suspectedCause: A black-and-white, low-contrast frame (a pale horse on a pale river bank). With no colour cue and little luminance separation between subject and background, the model finds no confident foreground.

investigation.finding: min 0.000 / mean 0.000 / max 0.000 — a hard zero, not a low-confidence mask.
The fp16 variant (model_512_int0_fp16.onnx) also returns empty, so this is not an int8 quantisation artefact.
Per-channel histogram stretch before inference leaves the mask max unchanged.
All four tiles return exactly 0.000 — a closer view does not help.
Threshold, feather and the refinement config all operate on a zero mask and cannot raise it.
